California Cannabis & Hemp Business Directory — AUDITED

Last audited: 1 November 2026. Cut-off: 1 November 2026. This file audits the attached directory only (see Scope below) and contains the audit table, the still-unverified list, the licensed-operators-moved-out list, the hemp-licence-only list, and the full corrected rewrite.

Cover — read first

Audited rows: 371. Verdicts: Confirmed 71, Corrected 58, Unverified 242, Removed 0, Already listed 0. Kept in the rewrite: 371 rows (Confirmed, Corrected and Unverified only, Unverified ones clearly flagged). Nothing was removed and nothing was moved out on suspicion alone, for the reasons stated under Method and limits.

Unique businesses: 367. The 371 rows include 4 businesses that appear in two category tables each and are counted once in the unique total: Omni Security Services (Categories 6 + 7), Operational Security Solutions / OSS (Categories 6 + 7), Green Road, a division of ADS Corporation (Categories 5 + 10), and Native Sage Environmental Consulting (Categories 5 + 10). Each keeps its row in both tables, as in the source. 371 rows − 4 second rows = 367 unique businesses.

Scope — only this file. At the user's instruction this audit references only the attached file (the REDO Complete directory, Categories 1–12, dated 1 November 2026). No other California directory, audit or report was opened or reused as a base, and no cross-directory comparison was made. That is why Already listed is 0: with only this file in scope there is no other list to compare against. Internal duplicates inside this file are flagged in the audit table and in the duplicate note below; they were not deleted. This is a business-directory audit only. It is not a law, tax or regulatory report, and no cannabis law, tax, licence-type or market discussion is included except a single fact where it is needed to decide whether a business belongs in the directory.

What "Unverified" means here. Unverified is not a finding that a business is closed or does not exist. Most Unverified rows are unconfirmed because the business's own site could not be opened in this pass (very often an upstream browser-service 429 rate-limit stop, which was not retried), because a credential lookup was form-gated, or because a contact or scope conflict in the source could not be resolved on the page actually opened. No search snippet, cached summary or directory listing was upgraded to Confirmed. Do not present an Unverified entry as confirmed currently operating until its own site is re-opened and the relevant lookup is run.

Method and limits — read before using any entry

  • Own site first, for every entry. Each checker's first step was a direct open of the business's own website. Where that open failed (429, 404, DNS/network error, bot wall, suspended hosting), the entry was marked Unverified and the failure is named in its audit row. A failed fetch does not prove closure.
  • DCC licence-search clearance is OUTSTANDING for all 371 rows. The DCC Cannabis Unified License Search is form-gated and was not run name-by-name to a conclusion in this audit. Inclusion here is therefore not proof of non-licensure, and no entry was moved out on a DCC suspicion alone. The flagged firms that most need that check are listed under Licensed operators moved out below.
  • Secretary of State bizfileOnline was likewise form-gated and was not run name-by-name; no dissolution, suspension or Franchise Tax Board suspension finding is asserted in this audit unless a checker found positive evidence elsewhere, and none was found to the removal threshold.
  • Credential lookups: State Bar of California Detail pages were opened directly for 13 attorneys (see Category 1–2 audit rows for the numbers); every other lawyer credential is Unverified because the CalBar name search is form-gated. California Board of Accountancy, CSLB Check-a-License, BSIS/DCA, California Department of Insurance and DRE lookups were form-gated or not opened to a result in this pass, so licence numbers marked "confirmed" in this file are confirmed only as published on the firm's own site, not as regulator-lookup clearances, unless the audit row says a Detail/lookup page was opened. No licence, bar or registration number was invented.
  • Contacts: only details the business itself publishes were adopted as corrections. Anything not found on the page opened reads "Not published — Verify" and was never guessed. Footer social links were captured in few text fetches, so a missing social link in this file is a fetch limitation, not a finding that the business has no social profile.
  • Hemp registrations: 0 verified CDFA/CDPH registration numbers in Category 12. The only CDPH claim found is Bailey's CBD for Pets ("Licensed by the California Department of Health Industrial Hemp Program for Production" on its own site), with no number published — recorded as a claim, not a verified number.
  • Same-name and place traps were checked against the row's own evidence (e.g. Pasadena CA vs Pasadena TX, Glendale CA vs Glendale AZ, Auburn CA vs Auburn AL/WA, Concord CA vs Concord NH/NC, Richmond CA vs Richmond VA, Ontario CA vs Ontario OR/Canada, Eureka CA vs Eureka NV/MO; Truckee CA kept separate from the Reno NV storefront; cities kept apart from unincorporated county areas). Where a city/county placement could not be confirmed on the page opened, the audit row says so.
